diagnostics.scope: Round timing includes anchor emission, proposal, target evaluation/sampling, rollback and accepted-token emission. scope: Forward-cost and numerical curves only. Fixed valid continuation, not naturally generated answers or deployable speculation. Hash/copy/compare and reset are outside evaluation timings.
keyguardPolicy: Test Activity may occlude keyguard using standard Activity APIs; it never dismisses authentication or loads personal app state.
numericTimingScope: Foreground numeric control; not model speed
